affiliateDisclosure.pageSubtitle: We are publishing Slim’s affiliate commission structure
affiliateDisclosure.commercialRelationBody1: Slim is a comparison service that earns affiliate commissions. If a user clicks "Change" on the results page, agrees to the terms, and then signs a contract on the provider's website, Slim receives a commission from certain providers.
affiliateDisclosure.commercialRelationBody2: This fee does not affect your bill. Even if we receive the fee, the ranking of the comparison results is determined by an algorithm, regardless of whether you are an affiliate. If you decline the offer, the comparison results will remain unchanged.
affiliateDisclosure.rankingAlgorithmBody1: The ranking is based solely on the amount saved, in descending order. Whether a product is an affiliate link or whether a commission is received does not affect the ranking.
affiliateDisclosure.rankingAlgorithmBody2Part1: This separation is enforced at the code level —
affiliateDisclosure.rankingAlgorithmBody2Part4: This separation is continuously verified through automated testing.
affiliateDisclosure.rankingAlgorithmBody3: Slim does not mix advertising content with comparison content. The comparison results are 100% algorithm-generated.
affiliateDisclosure.interstitialConsistencyBody: The principles on this page align with the text displayed in the consent interstitial that appears when you click the "Change" button. Both follow the same principles (no data transmitted, no impact on rankings or results if you opt out, and independence from comparison algorithms).
affiliateDisclosure.gdprRetentionBody: The legal basis for GDPR compliance regarding affiliate click records (Art. 6(1)(a) Consent) and the retention policy (click records: anonymized by setting to NULL after 90 days; settlement ledger: retained for up to 10 years in accordance with Belgian accounting obligations) are consistent with the Affiliate section of the Privacy Policy.

terms.pageDescription: Slim terms of use — service definition, disclaimer, governing law, operator identification.
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.draftNotice: These terms and conditions are a draft. They are not the final text until they have been reviewed by a legal agent (PLAN 4.12.f).
terms.serviceDefinitionBody: Slim is an information service that compares mobile plans in Belgium (BE), the Netherlands (NL), and Luxembourg (LU). Slim does not provide telecommunications services directly and is not a party to the contract between the provider and the user.
terms.comparisonDisclaimerBody: The rates and plan information displayed by Slim are presented exactly as provided by the supplier, without any modification. Savings estimates are based on arithmetic calculations using input assumptions (household type and estimated usage) and may differ from actual savings. Slim does not guarantee the completeness, accuracy, or timeliness of the comparison results. Please check the latest rates directly on the supplier’s official website before signing a contract.
terms.affiliateBody: Slim may receive affiliate commissions from certain providers. These commissions do not affect your rates, and the ranking of comparison results is determined by an algorithm, regardless of whether a commission is received. For more details, please refer to our Affiliate Commission Disclosure page.
terms.privacyRefBody: Our policy regarding the handling of personal information collected during the use of our services (such as household type, current service provider, and usage) is outlined in our Privacy Policy.
terms.liabilityBody: As an information service, Slim assumes no liability, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any damages resulting from the conclusion of a contract or a change in a rate plan based on the comparison results provided.
terms.governingLawBody: These Terms and Conditions shall be interpreted and governed in accordance with Belgian law. Any disputes shall be resolved by the competent courts of Belgium.
terms.operatorBody: The operator of this service is listed below. Please contact us via email with any inquiries.

privacy.pageDescription: Slim GDPR Art.13 Privacy Policy — data collected, legal basis, retention periods, data subject rights.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: This policy is a draft. It is not the final text until it has been reviewed by a legal agent (PLAN 4.12.f).
privacy.directCollectionNote: This Privacy Policy serves as a notice of direct collection in accordance with Article 13 of the GDPR. Slim does not collect personal data indirectly from third parties (excluded under Article 14).
privacy.controllerBody: The data controller for this service is as follows.
privacy.dpoBody: This service is not subject to the obligation to appoint a DPO under GDPR Article 37 (small-scale sole proprietorship, no high-risk processing).
privacy.processingHeading: 2. Purpose of Processing and Legal Basis (Art. 13 §1(c))
privacy.processingPA01Purpose: Purpose: To calculate and provide results of telecommunications plan comparisons based on user input (household type, current provider, and usage).
privacy.processingPA01LegalBasis: Legal basis: GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) — Performance of a contract for the use of comparison services.
privacy.processingPA01Data: Data collected: household type, current provider ID, usage by category. No postal/ZIP code is collected. No IP or device information is collected.
privacy.processingPA02Purpose: Purpose: To provide a permanent link (/r/[shortId]) — so you can revisit the comparison results at any time.
privacy.processingPA02LegalBasis: Legal basis: GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) — Performance of a contract.
privacy.processingPA03Purpose: Purpose: To record when a user has been redirected to a partner provider’s site after giving consent and to settle commissions.
privacy.processingPA03LegalBasis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) Consent (click history) + Art. 6(1)(c) Legal obligation (Belgian accounting retention requirements).
privacy.processingPA04Purpose: Purpose of processing: Detection of security incidents and monitoring of system anomalies.
privacy.processingPA04LegalBasis: Legal basis: Article 6(1)(f) (legitimate interests) — secure operation of the service.
privacy.processingPA05Heading: Sending a follow-up email regarding PA-05
privacy.processingPA05Purpose: Purpose: Send a single follow-up email 7 days after an attribution click (to measure beta conversion rates).
privacy.processingPA05LegalBasis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) Explicit consent (separate checkbox, pre-checked=false).
privacy.legitimateInterestBody: PA-04 Security Logs: Service security operations, such as the detection of fraud and malicious access, constitute a legitimate interest. Balance with the interests, rights, and freedoms of data subjects: The data collected is minimized and proportionate to the security objectives.
privacy.recipientsBody: PA-01/PA-02 comparison data is not transferred externally. The third-party data processors are listed below.
privacy.recipientSentry: Sentry — Error monitoring (security logs). Sentry Inc. (U.S., SCCs apply).
privacy.recipientPostHog: PostHog — Product Analytics (Security Logs). EU region option available.
privacy.recipientNeon: Neon — Database hosting. EU-Central-1 (Frankfurt). Neon DPA signed.
privacy.recipientVercel: Vercel — Service hosting. EU edge deployment (FRA1).
privacy.recipientResend: Resend — Send a follow-up email (PA-05). Use the EU region.
privacy.recipientAffiliateNote: Affiliate Redirect: The user navigates directly to the merchant's site via their browser. Slim does not transmit personal data to the merchant (not a third-party transfer under the GDPR).
privacy.internationalTransferBody: Neon, Resend, and PostHog use the EU region. Sentry is a U.S. entity, and data is transferred in accordance with the SCCs (Standard Contractual Clauses). Detailed compliance with the transfer requirements is scheduled to be confirmed following an external audit (immediately prior to the beta launch).
privacy.retentionPA01: Comparison request PII (household type, usage): 90 days after collection. After that, data is anonymized or set to NULL.
privacy.retentionPA02: Results of the comparison: Permanent retention (permanent link SLA). PII-derived fields in the results: Set to NULL after 90 days.
privacy.retentionPA03Click: Affiliate click FK: SET NULL after 90 days. Settlement field: Belgian accounting requirements (7–10 years).
privacy.retentionPA05Email: Email address: Set to NULL immediately after successful delivery. Meta column: Deleted after 90 days.
privacy.rightsBody: Data subjects may exercise the following rights. Please submit your request via email to the contact address below.
privacy.rightWithdraw: Right to Withdraw Consent (Art. 7(3)) — Consent for affiliate marketing, follow-up emails, and analytics cookies may be withdrawn separately.
privacy.withdrawConsentBody: Art. 6(1)(a) Consent-based processing (PA-03/PA-05/Analytics Cookies): You may withdraw your consent at any time. How to withdraw consent: Affiliate consent — Operator email. Follow-up emails — 1-click unsubscribe link in the email. Analytics Cookies — Cookie settings at the bottom of the page.
privacy.supervisoryHeading: 9. Right to File a Complaint with the Supervisory Authority (Art. 13 §2(d))
privacy.supervisoryBody: Data subjects may file a complaint with the following supervisory authority.
privacy.supervisoryBE: Belgium: Autorité de protection des données (APD) / Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit (GBA) — www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be
privacy.supervisoryLU: Luxembourg: Commission nationale pour la protection des données (CNPD) — www.cnpd.public.lu
privacy.obligationHeading: 10. Nature of the obligation to provide data (Art. 13 §2(e))
privacy.obligationBody: The information requested for the comparison (household type and usage) is necessary for the provision of the service (Art. 6(1)(b)). If this information is not provided, we will be unable to calculate the comparison results.
privacy.automatedDecisionBody: Slim's comparison engine performs only arithmetic calculations to determine potential savings. It does not involve automated individual decision-making or profiling as defined in GDPR Article 22. The ranking of comparison results is based on an arithmetic comparison of provider pricing data and the input assumptions, not on profiling based on personal characteristics.
privacy.contactBody: Please contact us at the email address below for inquiries regarding personal information or to exercise your rights.
